==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Trufitus]] in his house located north-east of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]]. {{Chat option|3It's a nice village, where is everyone?|1Me? How can I help?|1It sounds like just the challenge for me.}} Everytime you gather a new herb you need to go show it to [[Trufitus]] before being able to get a new kind of a herb.
}}

====Snake weed====
{{Checklist|
*Go south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai until green and yellow vines labelled '[[marshy jungle vine]]' are seen.
*Search the vines and clean the herb. Your character may spend several minutes finding a herb.
**'''Note:''' Take three if you intend to do [[Legends' Quest]] and [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]].
*Talk to Trufitus. Make sure you cleaned the herb. {{Chat option|1Of course!}}
}}

====Ardrigal====
{{Checklist|
*Head north-east from Trufitus. There will be [[Harpie Bug Swarm|Harpie Bug Swarms]] and palm trees.
*Search the [[palm tree (Ardrigal)|palm trees]] and clean the herb. 
**'''Note:''' Take two if you intend to do [[Legends' Quest]].
*Talk to Trufitus. {{Chat option|1Of course!}}
}}

====Sito foil====
{{Checklist|
*To the direct south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village is a patch of [[scorched earth]].
*Search the scorched earth (the squares immediately next to the fire) for the herb and clean it.
*Talk to Trufitus. {{Chat option|1Of course!}}
}}

====Volencia moss====
{{Checklist|
*Go south-east from Trufitus until you reach the [[Karamja Jungle mine]], marked with a [[File:Mining site icon.png]] pickaxe on minimap.
*Search the [[rock (volencia moss)|rocks]] for the herb and clean it.
**'''Note:''' Take two if you intend to do [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]] (possible required item).
*Talk to Trufitus. {{Chat option|1Of course!}}
}}

====Rogue's purse====
{{Checklist|
'''Note:''' The [[Rogue's purse]] must be obtained from the following method. Herbs gained anywhere else cannot be used.
*Go back by the Harpie Bug Swarms and head north-west until a cave is seen over the cavern. Search the [[rocks (Pothole Dungeon)|rocks]] and enter the cave.
*In the cave, head south, look for green spots on the wall labelled '[[Fungus covered Cavern wall]]', then search them and clean the herb. This process may take up to a minute. '''Do not try to use a Rogue's purse dropped by a Jogre. It <u>must</u> be obtained via searching the wall.'''
**'''Note:''' Take two if you intend to do [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]].
**Killing a Jogre inside this cave completes an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task, and is worth doing along the way.
*Talk to Trufitus. {{Chat option|1Of course!}}
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}

==Rewards==
{{Quest rewards page|Jungle Potion}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of Jungle Potion is required for the following:
*[[My Arm's Big Adventure]] - To work in the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] [[minigame]] during the quest
*[[Shilo Village]]
*[[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]]
*[[Zogre Flesh Eaters]]
*Several tasks in the [[Karamja Diary]]
